items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: Who was on a guitar? George Guino.

ctx.x: Do you have a guitar or a piano or what?
Ghetto. Who was on a guitar? George Guino. Oh, yeah.
Well, I put a pretty good band. Then I noticed in here you've got a write-up. Kid Howard, this is in a program, George Lewis New Orleans jazz band, a souvenir thing, from when he was in England.
